description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the SkillAPI in the OrangeHRM system. It tests CRUD operations like getAll, getOne, create, update, and delete via API endpoints for skills.

classes.name: SkillAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test suite for testing the SkillAPI endpoints related to skill management in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, resets Skill table data, and loads fixture data.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all skill entries via the SkillAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testGetAll method from a YAML test data file.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single skill by ID via the SkillAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for testGetOne from a YAML file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new skill via the SkillAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for testCreate from a YAML file.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing skill via the SkillAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for testUpdate from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a skill via the SkillAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for testDelete from a YAML file.
